## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `79305e90579ad3dadca3173c20af3c8be821d357`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md + packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts, packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts, packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts, packages/objectql/src/hook-notice.ts, skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs

Inputs read: card #28819 (body, triage 6684772134, claim 6685096576, dev report 6685780581); PR #30947 body, file list (4 files) and the `compare/main...79305e90` net diff (2 ahead, 0 behind); the check-runs on `79305e90`. The cited code was read at `79305e90`, which is `main` for every file outside the diff.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`ctx.notice` row (sandbox table) — right.** Name, shape and conditions match `HookContextSchema.notice` (`hook.zod.ts`: `HookNoticeSetter`, one `message: string` argument returning void, `.optional()`, "no capability token", "last call before the write answers wins", "present on every insert / update dispatch … absent on find and delete"), the engine's binder (`hook-notice.ts`: `NOTICE_EVENTS` = before/afterInsert, before/afterUpdate; `delete context.notice` on every other event) and the sandbox hand-over (`body-runner.ts` L1312–1316 `notice: engineCtx.notice`, hook face only; `quickjs-runner.ts` L951–973 `vm.setProp(ctxObj, 'notice', …)`, "No capability gate", synchronous). "Shown on the save toast" and "answered as the create/update `notice`" are what `rules/lifecycle.md` § Save Notice teaches on `main`. The row sits after `ctx.crypto` (last gated member) and before `ctx.title` (ungated helper): the table's order holds.
- **`notice?` member (one `message: string` argument, returns void) in the `HookContext` listing — right.** Optional on the schema (`z.unknown().optional()` cast to `HookNoticeSetter`), so `notice?` beside `api?` is the spec's own shape; a context parsed without a live engine has neither. The comment points at `rules/lifecycle.md` § Save Notice, the page that owns the rule.
- **Anchor `../rules/lifecycle.md#save-notice` — right.** `## Save Notice` exists at `rules/lifecycle.md` L144 on `main`; `Lint · docs & code guards` and `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (skill-refs / skill-docs) are green on this head.
- **SKILL.md L45 index clause — right.** The entry now names the save notice and `ctx.notice`, and L46 still routes to `references/data-hooks.md`, which now carries the member twice. `rules/lifecycle.md` L7 on `main` already says "and, at its end, the save notice a hook hands the saver", so the index describes the page as it is. Verify section untouched (queued #30893).
- **SKILL.md `lifecycle` row trim — right.** The dropped clause ("a `telemetry`/`transient`/`event`/`audit` class must declare a bounding policy or parsing fails") lives in the index entry one screen above ("❗ append-only objects must declare one") and in `rules/lifecycle.md` § Validation Rules ("rejected at parse time" … "Non-record class with no bounding policy"). The row keeps the bolded requirement and its link.
- **Three `data-hooks.md` deletions — homes verified at head:** (1) the "previously undocumented / reverse-engineer" aside is page history, not a rule, and the sentence keeps "the one a metadata-only runtime actually executes"; (2) the `tenantId` blockquote: first half is the listing comment at L589 ("The former `tenantId` alias was removed in v16"), second half is the "Two isolation axes" blockquote at L625–637 ("the generic driver-layer `tenantId` knob … a separate axis") — see ④ for the two symbol names it loses; (3) the `ctx.user` paragraph: "`undefined` for system / unauthenticated writes" is the table row at L360 and the listing comment at L603, and the `??` fallback is the code line at L622 directly above.
- **Token ratchet rows — right, both re-locked DOWN at the measurement.** Reproduced by the gate's own audit arithmetic (`ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`, stamp line unpriced) on the fetched files: `SKILL.md` 24331 bytes − 20-byte `  version: "18.3.0"` line → **6078** (main 24367 → 6087); `data-hooks.md` 40042 bytes → **10011** (main 40224 → 10056). Pinned 6123→6078 and 10066→10011, headroom 0 on both; no ceiling rises. `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (the ratchet's CI home) is green on `79305e90`.
- **Accept-set / public surface:** none. No schema, runtime or exported type changes; the skill bundle changes text only. The `@objectstack/skills` package is the only published artifact touched.
- **Check-runs on `79305e90` at write time:** every Lint, Type Check, Build, Changeset, Queue Guard, PR-body guard, Dogfood and Test UI family concluded `success`; `Test Core (1/8)` and `(2/8)` still `in_progress` (3/8 green). Those are package unit-test shards and read no `skills/**` file; no family that judges the `hits` files is outstanding.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/28819-save-notice-discoverable.md` — `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. Right: skill prose and two ratchet constants, no API or accepted-set change. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are on both the PR body and the changeset, no `(narrowing)` arm, so the PR is on the rules face (governed `skills/**` path) at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. `Check Changeset` and `check-changeset-no-major` green.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report `open_questions: []` — nothing to answer.
- Deviations (4): mistyped hooks path on a never-pushed first commit, re-committed as 6edbf15a with hooks running; edits in the linked worktree; harness assignee step skipped (seat sets it); worktree kept until landing. All procedural, none reaches the tree.
- `out_of_scope_findings`: `lifecycle` still described in two places in SKILL.md (row + index). Duplication, not a defect, not filed — accepted as noted; the card's own ask was the row clause only.
- PR body "Acceptance notes": `notice?` optional is not a defect — agreed, see ①.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED locally — CI's Lint families are green on this head, which covers it.
- No escalation needed.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`** — judged against the card's scenario (an author writing a save hook from this skill) and the spec it teaches on `main`.

- Holds. An author reaching the sandbox table or the `HookContext` listing now finds `notice`, its exact signature, its three conditions (no capability, insert/update only, last call wins) and the rule page. Each condition was checked against the binder, not the PR body: `hook-notice.ts` binds on the four insert/update events and deletes the member otherwise; the member itself refuses a non-string; the VM bridge installs it only when the host handed it over.
- Tried to break it: (a) "insert/update only" vs `beforeDelete`/`afterFind` — correct, the member is absent there; (b) `handler` door — `HookContextSchema` declares it, so a typed `handler` reads `ctx.notice?.()` with no TS2339, unlike `ctx.title`; the row rightly carries no "per door" caveat; (c) action bodies — `body-runner.ts` hands it over on the hook face only; the row's "insert/update only" already excludes actions, which have no such dispatch (observation, not a fix: the table's action parenthetical has never listed the hook-only members `title`/`dispatch` either); (d) "Capabilities — the complete list" still says "exactly five" tokens and `notice` adds none — consistent.
- **Should-fix** — deletion (2) loses two symbol names. The removed blockquote named `execCtx.tenantId` / `DriverOptions.tenantId`; the surviving "Two isolation axes" note at L633 says only "the generic driver-layer `tenantId` knob". The rule (separate axis, unaffected by the v16 alias removal) has its home; the two identifiers no longer appear anywhere in `skills/objectstack-data/`. Either add the two symbols to the two-axes note when headroom allows, or record the loss as intended. Not a must-fix: an author searching this skill for the hook-side org value still lands on `organizationId` and the two-axes rule.

**`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`** — judged against the card's reach (SKILL.md L45–46 is the only route from the skill into the save-notice teaching).

- Holds. L45 now names the save notice with the member spelled `ctx.notice`, L46 leads to `data-hooks.md` where the member is listed, and both point back to `rules/lifecycle.md` § Save Notice. The parenthetical "(distinct from lifecycle *hooks* below); plus the **save notice** a hook hands the saver" reads slightly against itself, but it is accurate: the page is the retention page and also where the notice is taught, exactly as its own L7 says.
- The `lifecycle` row trim loses no rule the skill does not state elsewhere (index entry + `rules/lifecycle.md` § Validation Rules).
- No must-fix.

**Cited gate — `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`** (read, not reviewed): both constants equal the head's measured counts; see ①.

- **Should-fix (nit)** — the `data-hooks.md` row comment nets "+95 … (-141)" = −46, while the pinned move from the `main` count is 10056→10011 = −45 (per-piece `ceil` rounding). The constant is right; only the comment's arithmetic is off by one.

No must-fix found in either `hits` file.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-q060ym`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibz5RLVEYDFco93jZ7u`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8111c0d57659bcf847eb53bbe78a50a1ae75786e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md + packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/driver.zod.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine-driver-options.ts, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs

Delta review on the previous PASS record for `79305e90` (PR comment of 2026-11-06T13:27Z). `8111c0d5` is one commit on `79305e90` (compare: 1 ahead, 0 behind) touching two files, `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` (+5/−4) and `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (+7/−5). `SKILL.md` and the changeset are byte-identical to the reviewed head. Only what moved is judged here; everything else in the earlier record stands.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Restored symbols — match `main`.** The two-axes note (L633) now names `execCtx.tenantId` / `DriverOptions.tenantId`. `ExecutionContext.tenantId` is declared at `packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.zod.ts` L135 and read by the engine as `execCtx.tenantId` (`packages/objectql/src/engine-driver-options.ts` L428, L497); `DriverOptions.tenantId` is `packages/spec/src/data/driver.zod.ts` L53 ("Tenant Isolation identifier"). The spec's own `session.organizationId` doc (`hook.zod.ts` L1205–1209) names exactly this pair as "a distinct, configurable axis", which is the sentence the note now carries. The earlier should-fix is closed.
- **Trim 1, `ctx.session` row (L361): "it was declared but never produced, so every read was `undefined`" to "(declared, never produced)" — no fact lost.** The spec tombstone (`hook.zod.ts` L1308–1318) says the key was DECLARED and NEVER PRODUCED on the hook path, so both readers "resolved `undefined` on every real engine path"; "never produced" entails that read result, and the spec itself names the pattern "declared-never-produced" (L1256). What an author needs survives: `ctx.session` has no role list, `session.roles` was retired in 17.0.0, and the Common Patterns warning at L849 ("Never gate this on a session claim: `ctx.session?.roles?.includes(…)`") is untouched.
- **Trim 2, `ctx.notice` row: "Rules: " prefix dropped — no fact lost.** The link text `rules/lifecycle.md § Save Notice` already names the rules page.
- **Trim 3, `notice?` listing comment: dash to colon — punctuation only.**
- **`ctx.notice` row — still correct.** Signature (one `message` argument, returns void), "answered as the create/update `notice`, shown on the save toast", "No capability; insert/update only; last call wins", link to `../rules/lifecycle.md#save-notice`: unchanged against `HookContextSchema.notice`, `hook-notice.ts` and the sandbox hand-over read for the previous record.
- **Ratchet constant — matches the measurement.** `data-hooks.md` at `8111c0d5` is 40042 bytes, `ceil(40042 / 4)` = **10011** = ceiling, headroom 0 (966 lines: the blockquote wraps onto one more line, same byte count). `SKILL.md` unchanged at 24331 bytes, 6078 with the stamp line unpriced. The row comment now reads "main measured 10056; the move is -45" — `main` is 40224 bytes → 10056, so −45 is exact; the earlier nit is closed. The comment also credits the `session.roles` clause as a payer, which is what the diff shows.
- **Accept-set / public surface:** none moved.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `.changeset/28819-save-notice-discoverable.md`, `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; prose and a comment only. `Check Changeset` green on `8111c0d5`.

### ③ Boundary flags

No new dev flags, no open questions on the delta commit. Both should-fixes from the `79305e90` record are addressed in the tree, not only in the account.

### ④ Design judgment

`skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` — judged against the earlier record's two should-fixes and the author scenario (writing a save hook, reading the org, checking isolation axes). The two-axes note now gives an author the two symbols to search for, under the rule that owns them; the three trims pay for it without removing a condition, a version or a warning. The `ctx.notice` teaching is the same contract as before. No must-fix, no should-fix.

`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (cited gate, read not reviewed): constant unchanged at 10011 and equal to the head's count; the comment's arithmetic is now right.

**Check-runs on `8111c0d5` at write time:** `success` — Auto Label, Build Core, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint · ESLint, Lint · repo & tooling gates (the token ratchet's CI home), Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards, Plan Test Core shards, Test UI, Type Check · source gates, filter (16). `in_progress` — Lint · CI release & engine gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Test Core (3 shards), Type Check · consumer gates / debt ledger / workspace (10). None failed. The ratchet gate has concluded green; `Lint · docs & code guards` (skill-refs / doc guards) is the one still-running family that reads the `hits` file, on a change that adds no link and no heading. 13 skipped (UI, opt-in and schedule jobs, as on the previous head).

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-q060ym`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibz5RLVEYDFco93jZ7u`

**VERDICT: PASS**

domain:skills#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibz5RLVEYDFco93jZ7u

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：让数据技能里的「保存提示」找得到。`SKILL.md` 规则索引里 `rules/lifecycle.md` 一条补一句：它也讲保存提示（不只是数据保留）。`references/data-hooks.md` 的沙箱 `ctx.*` 表加 `ctx.notice(message)` 一行（仅 insert/update，最后一次调用生效，不需要能力授权），HookContext 列表加 `notice?` 成员，都指向 `rules/lifecycle.md#save-notice`。另有 changeset。
- 为什么改：PR #28813 已在 `rules/lifecycle.md` 教了保存提示，但技能索引说那个文件只讲数据保留，钩子参考页也没有 `notice`，写保存钩子的 AI 找不到它。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文字和 changeset，不碰运行时。篇幅靠同文件删除换来（每处的去处在 PR 正文里写明），两行 token 上限都下调到实测：`SKILL.md` 6123 → 6078，`data-hooks.md` 10066 → 10011，没有上调。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` 新增的 `ctx.notice` 行和 `notice?` 成员。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n "notice" skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`，对照 `packages/objectql/src/hook-notice.ts`。
- 需要你做的：改的是 `skills/**`，属于 Tier H，需要 os-zhuang（或 hotlong）批准后才能合并。契约复审 PASS 6685938271，补改后增量复审 PASS 6686154027。

席位意见：契约复审 PASS，无必改；两条建议修改（删掉的 `execCtx.tenantId` / `DriverOptions.tenantId` 两个符号名、ratchet 注释的数字）开发已补上，增量复审无发现。可以批准。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · seat `domain:skills#2` · head `8111c0d5` · 2026-11-06T13:56Z

1. **Shape:** `Fixes #28819`, draft, base `main`, 4 files (`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` rule-index entry, `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` table row + HookContext member, `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` two rows down, `.changeset/28819-save-notice-discoverable.md` `'@objectstack/skills': patch`); content commit `6edbf15a`, a merge of `main` `33043bd8` (no file in common) and fix commit `8111c0d5`.
2. **Ruling:** filing gate ② on #28819 (open_question of PR #28813's dev report); blockers #28253 and #28730 closed completed; triage 6684772134 (p3); Claim 6685096576.
3. **Contract review:** PASS `6685938271` at `79305e90` (no must-fix, two should-fixes). Delta PASS `6686154027` at `8111c0d5` (same reviewer, no findings): the "Two isolation axes" note names `execCtx.tenantId` / `DriverOptions.tenantId` again (spec `execution-context.zod.ts`, `driver.zod.ts`), paid by three trims that lose no fact; the ratchet row comment states the net move 10056 → 10011 (−45). `ctx.notice` / `notice?` match main: `HookContextSchema.notice` optional, typed `HookNoticeSetter` (message string, returns void); `packages/objectql/src/hook-notice.ts` binds it on before/after insert and update only; the QuickJS sandbox installs it with no capability gate; the `#save-notice` anchor resolves in `rules/lifecycle.md`. All three same-file deletions have homes on the head. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
4. **Gates / check-runs:** dev reports 64 derived families, 63 exit 0, `dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED locally (needs every dist; CI runs it), base-sensitive families re-run green on the merged head (report 6685780581, lists `skills-seat-2/r2026-11-06/out/28819-*`). Ratchet rows re-locked at the measurement, headroom 0: `SKILL.md` 6078, `data-hooks.md` 10011. On head `8111c0d5`: 42 check-runs, 29 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed; mergeable_state clean. Refreshed os-dev-report 6686486027 (64 derived, 63 exit 0, `dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED, CI green).
5. **Accepted deviations:** the PR body is not patched and is stale in three places (the deletion list, the `notice?` comment punctuation, the head in the readings); this ACCEPT and the delta record carry the head-`8111c0d5` facts. The dev's first local commit ran without the pre-commit hook (never pushed) and was redone as `6edbf15a` with hooks. Both review should-fixes are closed on this head.
6. **Landing:** GOVERNED, Tier H (`skills/**`). The seat readies the PR and the relay's governed-review leg requests the approvers; no auto-merge is armed by the seat.
